$comment: TENANCY GROUNDWORK 2026-11-13 — where each table lives once a client can have its own database. platform = always the primary (people, sign-in, workspaces, money, the survey-link directory); customer = the client's database; shared = cross-client by design (a central store fed by every database); review = a decision is still needed. Every table in supabase/migrations must be listed here — scripts/tenancy-audit.mjs fails otherwise. Drafted from the live schema's columns (2026-11-13), corrected by hand; the 'review' rows are open questions.
